column1: # WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AND THE 2026-10-11 ONE DOES NOT CARRY ITS OWN ROWS.
# UNREACHABLE" and "the other 15 are NOT yet fixed and are listed here so the
# next pass has the measurement rather than the inference" -- but that file has
# had 24 lines and ZERO data rows since the commit that created it. The rows
# were never written, so CLAUDE.md was pointing the next pass at nothing. This
# redoes the measurement over all 101 candidates (not just the 42 literal ones)
# METHOD, and the correction it needed. For each candidate whose URL is a
# complete literal, ask the upstream the SAME question with a tenfold limit and
# compare record counts (verify_feeds' own count_json/count_feed/count_csv, so a
# record means here what it means to the rest of the tree).
# THAT TEST ALONE OVER-REPORTS, and od_udata_pt.c is the proof: it answered 200
# for one request and 2,000 for a tenfold ask, which looks exactly like a
# discard -- but od_udata_collect() already walks it with pw_walk, so its
# page_size=200 is a PAGE SIZE. A one-request-vs-one-request comparison cannot
# see a collector that follows pages. Every TRUNCATING candidate here was
# therefore also read in its collector to ask whether anything pages it, and
# the fixes were proved by running the source before and after.
# 26 of 101 truncate on a single request. 6 sites are FIXED here; the rest carry
# the reason they are not, which is the thing the 10-11 file meant to record.
#   NOT_FIXED_CROSS_PAGE            1   per-page emit would be WRONG, not just partial
#   NOT_FIXED_NO_CONTINUATION      17   no next link, no offset/page in the URL
#   NOT_FIXED_QUESTION_NOT_DISCARD  1   newest-first feed; the limit is the question
#   PAGES_ALREADY                   1   false positive of the single-request test
# Measured recovery from the 6 fixed, run before and after through
# Every one of those lands on the 20-page ceiling, so each now also files a
# truncation notice and the real totals are larger still. bdc-stac is 0 both
# before and after: data.inpe.br is unreachable from the authoring container
# (SSL connect error), which the collector reports as rc=-1 rather than hiding.
# A `tenfold_ask` of 1000/2000/5000 is this test's own ceiling, not the
# upstream's total, so the shortfall on those rows is at least that large.
